source.title: Dapagliflozin in Heart Failure: A Comprehensive Meta-analysis on Functional Capacity, Symptoms, and Safety Outcomes

atoms.canonical_statement: The systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated dapagliflozin versus placebo/control in heart failure, focusing on functional capacity and symptoms (6-minute walk distance and KCCQ) and on hospitalization, all-cause mortality, and adverse events.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: aimed to assess the comparative effects of dapagliflozin versus placebo in patients with heart failure

atoms.canonical_statement: Eligible studies were randomized clinical trials enrolling adults with heart failure, including HFrEF or HFpEF.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: individuals with heart failure, including those with either preserved or reduced ejection fraction

population.label: Adults with heart failure (HFrEF or HFpEF)
inclusion_criteria: Heart failure with preserved or reduced ejection fraction

atoms.canonical_statement: The intervention of interest was dapagliflozin added to standard therapy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: dapagliflozin plus standard therapy

exposures.details: Most included HF trials used dapagliflozin 10 mg once daily on top of usual/standard therapy; individual-trial regimens varied.

atoms.canonical_statement: The comparator was standard therapy/control, generally placebo plus background therapy in the contributing trials.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: comparator (C): standard therapy

exposures.details: Control was placebo or standard therapy according to the included trial.

atoms.canonical_statement: PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched through January 2024.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Cochrane Library databases were searched until January 2024

atoms.canonical_statement: The database search combined dapagliflozin synonyms (including Farxiga/BMS512148) with heart-failure terms spanning systolic/HFrEF and diastolic/HFpEF terminology.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: primary search terms were as follows (Dapagliflozin OR “Farxiga” OR “BMS512148” OR “BMS-512148”)

atoms.canonical_statement: Two reviewers independently screened titles/abstracts and full text; disagreements were resolved by a third author, with Rayyan used for screening.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Two reviewers (B.A. and S.I.) independently performed title and abstract screening. Conflicts were resolved through a third author (W.A.)

atoms.canonical_statement: Risk of bias was assessed with the revised Cochrane RoB 2 tool across randomization, deviations from intended intervention, missing outcome data, outcome measurement, and selective reporting domains.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The revised Cochrane risk-of-bias tool for RCTs (ROB2) was used

atoms.canonical_statement: RevMan version 5.3 was used for the meta-analysis.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: RevMan v5.3 was used to conduct the statistical analysis

atoms.canonical_statement: The methods specified risk ratios for dichotomous outcomes and mean differences with 95% confidence intervals for continuous outcomes.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: risk ratio (RR) was used to synthesize dichotomous outcomes, and the mean difference (MD) with 95% confidence interval (CI) was used to pool continuous outcomes

atoms.canonical_statement: Heterogeneity was evaluated using chi-square and I-squared statistics, with chi-square alpha <0.10 treated as evidence of heterogeneity.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Chi-square and I2 tests were both used in the assessment of heterogeneity

atoms.canonical_statement: Leave-one-out sensitivity analysis was planned to address heterogeneity by sequentially removing individual studies.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Leave-one-out sensitivity analysis was used to resolve heterogeneity
